originals.json.qualification: Original upstream 5 MiB RDG seed 0/compressibility 0.5 construction, negative block-size level, single/two-frame assertions and shared allocation with real guards executed in normal and ASan/UBSan oracles. LeakSanitizer unsupported on macOS and disabled. Rust replay remains pending.

native.json.qualification: All layouts use one real shared allocation, both guard bands and the configured output allowance are checked. Native unused-success-suffix preservation is observed rather than assumed; Rust has its own stronger suffix contract. Normal and address/undefined sanitized verdicts and output bytes agree. No LeakSanitizer credit on unsupported macOS.

rust.json.qualification: 1300 native same-allocation layouts captured and replayed across safe/move/history/combined/all Rust configurations. 1291 verdicts agree; nine zero-input layouts retain the established Rust UnexpectedEof versus native empty-concatenation success difference. Every common success output matches exactly; all Rust backends agree, preserve guards/allowance and the entire unused successful suffix. No nonempty verdict differences. Original 5 MiB assertions retain their actual native-generated input construction.

replay.json.qualification: The final two ignored native adapter tests were explicitly executed in five configurations. 1300 layouts plus the original expanded 5 MiB single-frame and two-frame assertions pass. Native empty-input acceptance remains an explicitly labelled difference.
